submitted.rationale: EQE kept rising as the Sb fraction increased: 0.037% at index 19 (the NiSb2O6 stoichiometry), 0.065% at index 24, and 0.089% at index 28, which is the most Sb-rich composition in the library. So the best composition is at the Sb-rich end.

rejected.reason: Close to the NiSb2O6 trirutile composition, but its measured EQE (0.037%) was the lowest of the three
